records.stdout:
{
  "ok": true,
  "value": {
    "project": "IntendedTarget",
    "systems": [
      {
        "id": "world",
        "summary": "Entity、Transform 與 Sprite 的 ECS world state。",
        "status": "available",
        "default_enabled": true,
        "optional": false,
        "luau_api": [
          "api.entity.*"
        ],
        "observation": [
          "world.entities"
        ],
        "when_disabled": "沒有 world 就沒有可觀測的遊戲狀態，因此不可關閉。",
        "disable_when": "不適用。",
        "enabled": true,
        "source": "default"
      },
      {
        "id": "input",
        "summary": "語意 action 與 world/screen pointer 的 host 輸入邊界。",
        "status": "available",
        "default_enabled": true,
        "optional": false,
        "luau_api": [
          "api.input.isDown",
          "api.input.pointer"
        ],
        "observation": [
          "world.pointer"
        ],
        "when_disabled": "沒有 input 就無法重播 deterministic 測試，因此不可關閉。",
        "disable_when": "不適用。",
        "enabled": true,
        "source": "default"
      },
      {
        "id": "observation",
        "summary": "typed ViewModel 的 semantic projection 與 observation digest。",
        "status": "available",
        "default_enabled": true,
        "optional": false,
        "luau_api": [
          "api.observation.set"
        ],
        "observation": [
          "observation",
          "observation_digest"
        ],
        "when_disabled": "沒有 observation 就無法做 semantic assertion，因此不可關閉。",
        "disable_when": "不適用。",
        "enabled": true,
        "source": "default"
      },
      {
        "id": "physics2d",
        "summary": "2D 剛體的 fixed-step 積分：重力、linear damping、地面反彈與摩擦、圓形碰撞，並發布每一幀的接觸點。沒有角速度、沒有非圓形碰撞體、沒有 sensor 與 raycast。",
        "status": "available",
        "default_enabled": true,
        "optional": true,
        "luau_api": [
          "api.physics.applyImpulse",
          "api.entity.despawn"
        ],
        "observation": [
          "world.entities[].rigidbody",
          "world.contacts",
          "world.ground_contacts"
        ],
        "when_disabled": "關閉後引擎不再推進任何剛體、也不發布任何 contact；RigidBody2D 會保持 scene 的初始值，api.physics 會回報 SYSTEM_DISABLED。",
        "disable_when": "棋盤、放置、AVG、老虎機這類沒有物理模擬的遊戲；關閉可移除每 frame 的積分成本與非必要的 digest 變動來源。",
        "enabled": false,
        "source": "project"
      },
      {
        "id": "camera2d",
        "summary": "2D 相機位置與縮放。",
        "status": "available",
        "default_enabled": true,
        "optional": true,
        "luau_api": [
          "api.camera.setPosition",
          "api.camera.setZoom"
        ],
        "observation": [
          "world.camera"
        ],
        "when_disabled": "關閉後 api.camera 會回報 SYSTEM_DISABLED，snapshot 仍輸出預設相機讓 host 有固定視野。",
        "disable_when": "固定畫面、不捲動的遊戲。",
        "enabled": true,
        "source": "default"
      },
      {
        "id": "camera3d",
        "summary": "3D 相機與 Mesh3D/Transform3D 的觀測投影。",
        "status": "available",
        "default_enabled": true,
        "optional": true,
        "luau_api": [
          "api.camera3d.setPosition",
          "api.camera3d.setTarget"
        ],
        "observation": [
          "world.camera3d",
          "world.entities[].mesh3d"
        ],
        "when_disabled": "關閉後 api.camera3d 會回報 SYSTEM_DISABLED；api.entity 的 3D transform 目前不受此開關影響。",
        "disable_when": "純 2D 遊戲；關閉可讓「這個專案不該出現 3D 相機」變成可驗證的事實。",
        "enabled": true,
        "source": "default"
      },
      {
        "id": "random",
        "summary": "以 seed 決定、可重播的遊戲亂數。",
        "status": "available",
        "default_enabled": true,
        "optional": true,
        "luau_api": [
          "api.random.nextFloat",
          "api.random.nextInt"
        ],
        "observation": [],
        "when_disabled": "關閉後 api.random 會回報 SYSTEM_DISABLED。",
        "disable_when": "完全 deterministic、不允許任何亂數來源的遊戲或關卡驗證。",
        "enabled": true,
        "source": "default"
      },
      {
        "id": "ui",
        "summary": "engine 驗證的最小 UI tree 傳輸（screen/text/button/rect/action）。",
        "status": "available",
        "default_enabled": true,
        "optional": true,
        "luau_api": [
          "api.ui.setRoot"
        ],
        "observation": [
          "ui"
        ],
        "when_disabled": "關閉後 api.ui 會回報 SYSTEM_DISABLED，host 不會收到 UI tree。",
        "disable_when": "只有 headless 模擬或由 host 自行組 UI 的遊戲。",
        "enabled": true,
        "source": "default"
      },
      {
        "id": "save",
        "summary": "遊戲自訂版本與 migration 的 JSON save payload 傳輸。",
        "status": "available",
        "default_enabled": true,
        "optional": true,
        "luau_api": [
          "api.save.set",
          "api.save.get"
        ],
        "observation": [
          "save_payload"
        ],
        "when_disabled": "關閉後 api.save 會回報 SYSTEM_DISABLED。",
        "disable_when": "沒有存檔的關卡驗證或 demo。",
        "enabled": true,
        "source": "default"
      },
      {
        "id": "spine",
        "summary": "Spine 骨骼動畫：遊戲發布語意動畫狀態，host 執行 Spine runtime。",
        "status": "host_required",
        "default_enabled": false,
        "optional": true,
        "luau_api": [
          "api.animation.play",
          "api.animation.stop"
        ],
        "observation": [
          "world.entities[].animation"
        ],
        "when_disabled": "關閉後 api.animation 會回報 SYSTEM_DISABLED，scene 宣告的 animation 仍會出現在 snapshot。",
        "disable_when": "沒有骨骼動畫的遊戲；這是預設關閉的系統。目前只有 web/presentation 這個 Web host 會以 spine-webgl 播放，native preview 與 Android host 都不會；引擎只負責傳輸與 determinism。",
        "enabled": false,
        "source": "default"
      },
      {
        "id": "effekseer",
        "summary": "Effekseer 特效：遊戲發布語意特效事件，host 執行 Effekseer runtime。",
        "status": "host_required",
        "default_enabled": false,
        "optional": true,
        "luau_api": [
          "api.effect.spawn",
          "api.effect.stop"
        ],
        "observation": [
          "world.effects"
        ],
        "when_disabled": "關閉後 api.effect 會回報 SYSTEM_DISABLED，snapshot 不會有任何 effect。",
        "disable_when": "沒有粒子特效的遊戲；這是預設關閉的系統。目前只有 web/presentation 這個 Web host 會以 Effekseer for WebGL 播放，native preview 與 Android host 都不會；引擎只負責傳輸與 determinism。",
        "enabled": false,
        "source": "default"
      }
    ]
  },
  "diagnostics": [],
  "effects": []
}
